findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed to subclass StatefulDetectorHandler but provides no implementations. StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data. A subclass that does not override them remains abstract, so group_type.detector_handler(self) in src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class. process_detectors does not catch this, so any detector of this type will crash evaluation instead of being skipped.

findings.title: get_state_data KeyErrors when counter_names is empty
findings.body: get_state_data initializes counter_updates as {} and only populates it inside if self.counter_names:. The result construction unconditionally does counter_updates[gk]. When a detector defines counter_names as an empty list, which the if-guard explicitly anticipates, this raises KeyError for every group key. The fallback for no counters should be None or {} per key, not a missing dict entry.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says list after change to dict
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate was changed to return dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but its docstring still says it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult with one result per group key. Readers of only the docstring will expect the old contract.
